restaurant_name: G&M Health Care Clinic | The Drip Bar Phuket
text:
Perfect place if you want to support recovery, hydration, energy, and overall wellness while in Phuket.

The whole team was so welcoming, professional, and attentive from the moment I walked in. The atmosphere is clean, relaxing, and calming, making the entire experience feel really comfortable.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality IV therapy and genuinely caring staff 🙏🏽💖

restaurant_name: G&M Health Care Clinic | The Drip Bar Phuket
text: I recently visited this place for an IV drip, and I was really impressed with the whole experience. The staff were very professional and made me feel comfortable right away. The procedure was quick and painless, and the environment was clean and relaxing. After the IV drip, I felt refreshed, more energetic, and much better overall. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a boost in their health and wellness!

restaurant_name: G&M Health Care Clinic | The Drip Bar Phuket
text: The Drip Bar is a fantastic business located inside the Radisson Red, run by some of the nicest people you’ll ever meet. Gem, who leads the team, did an excellent job explaining the wide range of drips available and clearly outlining their benefits. The option of receiving the drip either in your room or at the clinic was extremely convenient. What truly sets this service apart is the team’s dedication and 24/7 availability. Gem provides outstanding customer care both before and after the treatment, and I can only thank her and her friendly team for their absolutely amazing service. Without a doubt, this is a must-visit for anyone coming to Phuket!

restaurant_name: G&M Health Care Clinic | The Drip Bar Phuket
text: After a rough case of food poisoning followed by a nasty hangover, the Hangover Rescue Drip was a lifesaver. Within the first hour, the hydration, electrolytes, and vitamins started kicking in nausea eased, energy came back, and the brain fog lifted. For food poisoning, it was especially helpful in rehydrating quickly and restoring balance when I couldn’t keep anything down. This treatment is a game changer if you need to bounce back fast and feel human again!

restaurant_name: G&M Health Care Clinic | The Drip Bar Phuket
text: My partner and I got violently sick about 24 hours before our flight back to the USA. I reached out to The Drip Bar (after being stood up by a different place). The nurses fit us in about 12 hours ahead of the flight, giving us time to rest after the IV treatment. Their professional nurses came to our hotel room, they were so caring and helpful, and they were comforting to talk to. They gave us the stomach bug drip and also left us with some nausea pills etc for the flight. I learned that it’s important to find a reputable IV provider with a physical clinic and licensing, even if they are doing a home visit for you. These two nurses seriously helped us out so much!! I don’t think we could do this flight without the care they provided. Thank you team! ❤️‍🩹
